+SKU and name whitespace and stores SKU keys in lowercase. Case variants refer

+updates that key while preserving other stored items. Any malformed row rejects
+the entire import and leaves the catalog unchanged.

+python3 catalog.py --db catalog.sqlite import daily.csv

+return a nonzero exit status without a traceback. Empty and header-only files
+make no item changes.
